summary: Implemented settings.merge.merge per ADR-004 (recursive dict merge, lists and scalars replaced, None unsets a key, inputs never mutated and result deep-copied) and added tests for each rule plus layered load; 8 tests pass.
assumptions: None values inside an override sub-dict with no dict counterpart in base are dropped too (sub-dict merged against {}).
A dict override replaces a non-dict base value and vice versa, per 'any other value replaces'.
The result is deep-copied so it shares no mutable containers with the (cached) input layers.
None inside lists is kept verbatim; only dict values of None unset keys.
